messages:
anya: Quick heads-up — roadmap sync in 30. We need to lock console observability scope for the Q3 launch. Top asks: token-level cost breakdown, model-aware tracing hooks, and error analytics with regression alerts. Who can own the spec?
kevin: I can take spec ownership if product OKs scope. Need to clarify acceptance criteria and what 'token-level' means for billing vs UX.
maria: +1 to @kevin. From customer feedback: sample UIs they want are 1) per-route cost waterfall, 2) per-model tail-latency chart, 3) error fingerprinting list with example traces.
sam: Engineering constraints: tracing hooks need low-overhead envelope. Proposal: SDK emits lightweight trace_id + model_version on calls; server-side sampling for full traces. Example config we can support: `trace.sample_rate=0.05` and `trace.include_model=true`.
lee: SRE note — cardinality explosion is real. We should limit tags: model_version, route, region. No freeform user metadata in initial rollout. Also retention: 30 days for full traces, 90 days for aggregated metrics.
maria: Acceptance criteria draft: - Dashboards surface per-route token cost and per-model cost delta - Tracing hooks record model_version and request path, sampled at config rate - Error analytics groups by stack fingerprint and shows top 20 regressions
kevin: For launch gating: metrics must show <5% added p99 latency for API calls (measured in canary). Also rollouts: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback on error spike.
sam: Implementation notes: we'll add a server header `X-Trace-Model: <model>@<ver>` so tools can route. Example return header: `X-Trace-Model: llama-3-7b@2025-09-10`. Also will add a sampling hook in the routing layer to avoid additional RPCs.
lee: Ops requirement: provide cost query that runs under 500ms for UI requests. If aggregations are slow, we need pre-aggregated tiles.
maria: Tradeoffs: no full-heatmap or per-token trace in v1. We'll aim for aggregated token-cost per minute and per-route bucket. That keeps storage sane.
anya: Decision: @kevin owns spec, @sam leads infra implementation, @maria owns acceptance/ux. Deliverables: spec draft by Fri (1755380000), mockups by next Wed, canary plan in playbook.
ops-bot: Reminder: synced calendar invite created: https://meet.redwood.ai/obs-roadmap-sync (today 30m) :calendar:
kevin: I'll kick off spec doc now. Ping me in this thread if you have small asks; I'll add them as ACs. :thumbsup:
